These are genuine metric fluctuations of the full supplied action, not an added spectator scalar.

exact_zero_modes.interpretation: Two torus complex-structure moduli survive. Fixed coordinate periods and discrete SL2Z identifications do not remove their local continuous fluctuations. Canonical matter, wall tension and global volume/fourflux constraints do not lift them.
